matching: greedy: predictions by confidence (highest first), each to the unmatched ground-truth box of the same class with the highest IoU, a TP if IoU >= 0.5; FP = unmatched predictions, FN = unmatched ground truth; tp_any_class: the same matching ignoring the class
fully_correct: n_gt >= 1 and TP == n_gt and FP == 0
f1: per image 2 TP / (2 TP + FP + FN); mean over the images with n_gt >= 1
image_export: selected images copied unchanged if the long side is <= 1280 px, else downscaled to 1280 px (JPEG quality 92)
